doc.title: Mrs. Mary Lucy Hamill O'Kelly Interview, 1958-05-04

title: Halfway House Orchestra and her dislike of jazz
summary: The interviewer helps identify the band as the Halfway House Orchestra, which children loved while she found jazz dreadful.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands

blocks.x: No, I don't know what band it was. It was the Halfway House. The Halfway House, and I think it, that probably was the Dixie Lane Jazz Band now, don't you think?
It's called the Halfway House Orchestra.

It's called the Halfway House Orchestra. It's called the Halfway House Orchestra. And the children thought it was wonderful. I thought it was, all this jazz was dreadful and I still do. Tell her yes. I'll ring her up later. Tell her here. And, uh, where was I? Oh, yes.
